purpose: Local validation of the clean detent-to-carrier attachment; assembled-part validation is separate

attachment_regularization.affected_sections: Only the shoulder and crown profiles; all lower detent profiles are retained
attachment_regularization.reason: The measured shoulder nearly coincides with the carrier outline. A contained attachment avoids sliver faces; the explicit shoulder-point displacement is below 0.012 mm, and the cap extends 0.0024 mm to the carrier crown. Full source-fidelity validation remains separate.

native_union: Ordinary native BRep union; no glue shortcut, no fuzzy tolerance, no global face unification
